thread:
mina: kicking off staged bring-up for rwd-v4-int4. main win is cost but we need to be strict on semantic fidelity for the "long-answer" and "citation" slices. proposing a slice-aware hold mechanism that prevents promotion if any critical slice regresses.

diego: love slice-aware gating. what's the concretely failing slice today?

mina: small drop in rerank-MRR on the 'long-answer' slice (~2.2% relative vs v4-fp16 baseline) during a 30m shadow run. overall chat metrics are flat.

zhen: 2.2% is borderline. do we have per-example noise? sample sizes?

mina: sample sizes: long-answer ~480 reqs per 30m. using bootstrap CI we see lower bound ~-3.4% so non-trivial. proposing these rules:

- canary windows: 20m
- min_samples_per_window: 150
- slices_monitored: [long-answer, citation, rationale]
- metrics: rerank_MRR_rel, rougeL_rel, embed_cosine_delta_rel
- per-slice threshold: rerank_MRR_rel > -1.0% (if worse -> hold), rougeL_rel > -1.5%, embed_cosine_delta_rel > -0.008
- global pass requires all monitored slices to be within thresholds for 2 consecutive windows (hysteresis)
- auto-backoff: if any slice breaches threshold in 3 out of the last 5 windows -> immediate rollback and pager to SRE

mina: also add a ramp backoff function: on a single breach during promotion, reduce traffic to previous step and re-evaluate for 30m instead of immediate rollback. only escalate if repeated.

diego: sounds solid. infra items: ensure we run rerank eval on the live responses not cached ones, and tag requests so we can filter out warmup noise.

zhen: add to that: kv-cache warmup will bias p95 downwards; metric derivation must exclude first-5 requests per replica.

mina: good catch. we'll filter first-5 per-replica in the canary calc.

ops-bot: runbook link: https://runbooks.internal/rwd/canary-slice-hold (added)

deploy-bot: scheduled promote by mina for 2024-06-02T14:00:00Z with policy file infra/slice-hold-v4-int4.yaml

diego: question on telemetry: can we push a per-slice drift alert to the console dashboard at roll steps? I want a small heatmap.

zhen: yes, create a row per slice + metric delta; also include CI bands so ops can see significance.

mina: operational checklist before starting:
- confirm policy file in infra repo (I'll open PR)
- add warmup hook to routing (first-5 exclusion)
- create shadow eval job for long-answer corpus at 5m cadence
- ensure hysteresis implemented (2 green windows to step)

mina: plan: mini-sweep in staging now (shadow), if stable then canary 0.5% -> 2% -> 10% with holds. tagging @diego for infra prep and @zhen for metric validation.

diego: prepping warmup hook, ETA 2 hours.

zhen: validating metric pipeline, will post results in this thread.

mina: thanks team. will update once PR is up. :rocket:
